analysis.title: GS Garrett - week(day) prep ... positioning / performance 2 Oct 2026 (includes Prime Insights & Analytics: September 2026 First Look on Hedge Fund Performance and Positioning)
key_insights: Net exposure to US equities is at 1, 3 and 5 year lows with one quarter left in 2026, per the GS Prime Brokerage (PB) team.
The desk says the disparity across global exposure is extreme, with hedge funds max long Asia and Europe.
The desk says 'not bullish America' is a crowded trade.
The desk says that if the idea of 'spx 8100' hurts at the business level, upside is not expensive.
Brian Garrett says he would fall in the consensus on tight nets, given rates, oil, geopolitics, credit and bonds, and notes the view is extremely consensus.
Global Fundamental L/S managers finished September at -0.55%, outperforming the market benchmark.
Global equities were modestly net sold in September: short sales slightly outpaced long buys, and gross trading activity rose at the fastest pace in 4 months.
Overall book and Global Fundamental L/S gross leverage rose in September, while net leverage fell modestly.
Regional flows: net selling in EM Asia and North America was mostly offset by large net buying in Europe.
US sector flows: hedge funds rotated into TMT stocks in September while nearly every other sector was net sold.
